summary: Iteration 231 - Batch 19 (Cross-Channel Sentiment Heatmap) tested. Backend: 19/19 passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified. Sentiment Heatmap Panel accessible via sidebar '💗 Sentiment Heatmap' (data-testid='sentiment-heatmap-btn'). Panel shows hero stats (overall score, NPS-like, positive/neutral/negative counts), channel bars, 10-topic × 3-band heatmap, top praises/complaints, and daily trend. Drilldown modal opens on topic cell click showing filtered responses sorted by score. All regression tests for Batches 13-18 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Sentiment is LEXICON-based (no LLM call) - fast and $0 cost
Data sources: reviews, unified_inbox, mid_stay_responses, survey_responses, post_stay_surveys
10 Turkish/English mixed topics: Personel/Staff, Oda/Room, Yemek/F&B, Konum/Location, Wi-Fi/Internet, Check-in/Check-out, Klima/Comfort, Temizlik/Cleanliness, Fiyat/Value, Gürültü/Noise
Band thresholds: score >= 2 = positive, score <= -2 = negative, else neutral
Top praises/complaints limited to 10 items, text snippets max 300 chars
Drilldown returns rows sorted by score (negatives first)
seed_data_creation: None - uses existing reviews data (38 responses found)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 231 validates Batch 19 (Cross-Channel Sentiment Heatmap). Sidebar button: '💗 Sentiment Heatmap' (data-testid='sentiment-heatmap-btn'). Topic rows: data-testid='topic-row-{topic}'. Top sections: data-testid='top-praises', 'top-complaints'. Drilldown modal: data-testid='sentiment-drill'. Backend endpoints: GET /api/sentiment/heatmap/{property_id}?days=N, GET /api/sentiment/drilldown/{property_id}?topic=X&days=N&band=Y.

heatmap_endpoint.by_channel: Returns channel breakdown with count, avg, pos, neu, neg
heatmap_endpoint.topic_matrix: Returns 10 topics × 3 bands (positive, neutral, negative, total)
heatmap_endpoint.top_praises: Returns up to 10 praises with score, channel, author, topics, text (max 300 chars)
heatmap_endpoint.top_complaints: Returns up to 10 complaints with same structure
heatmap_endpoint.trend: Returns daily entries with date, count, avg

drilldown_endpoint.row_structure: Each row has text, score, band, channel, author, created_at

ui_elements.hero_stats: GENEL SKOR, NPS-BENZERİ, POZİTİF, NÖTR, NEGATİF counts
ui_elements.topic_table: 10 rows with clickable cells for drilldown
